title: Bay State Gas Company files for approval an interruptible transportation service contract with Newark Atlantic Paperboard Corporation of Lawrence, Massachusetts.
petitioner: Bay State Gas Company d/b/a Columbia Gas
filings: The Agreement between Bay State Gas Company and the Newark Atlantic Paperboard Corporation is hereby APPROVED. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr.
